steps.en: OCMS looks for earlier submissions on the same notice
steps.id: OCMS mencari submission sebelumnya pada notice yang sama

steps.en: Only earlier submissions by the same owner count
steps.id: Hanya submission sebelumnya dari owner yang sama yang dihitung
steps.why_en: The automatic check counts any earlier submission on the notice, whoever sent it.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan otomatis menghitung submission sebelumnya pada notice itu, siapa pun pengirimnya.

steps.en: Only an earlier rejected submission triggers the check
steps.id: Hanya submission sebelumnya yang rejected yang memicu pengecekan
steps.why_en: Any earlier submission triggers it, including pending and approved ones, not only rejected.
steps.why_id: Submission sebelumnya apa pun memicunya, termasuk pending dan approved, bukan hanya rejected.

steps.en: A request with an earlier submission waits for an officer
steps.id: Request yang punya submission sebelumnya menunggu officer

steps.en: OCMS marks the request as a resubmission
